post.description: Open a session: the access token, and the refresh token in its cookie.
Revoke the session's refresh token and delete its cookie.

get.description: The signed-in board member, as shown in the board space.

Record the password chosen from a link, which then holds no more. No
session opens: the member signs in, their address filled in.
The account a link leads to, while the link holds: the page names it.

post.description: Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie.

get.description: Every account, with its state, by name.

link the email gives. The answer tells whether the email went out.
« Envoyer un nouveau lien »: an invitation again, or a password forgotten.

get.description: The albums, by page, the latest first: those of an event, when one is given.

delete.description: Delete an album, its photos and their files.

get.description: An album and every photo of it: 300 at most.

put.description: One of the album's photos, or none.

metadata, in three sizes.

done (D17).

How many documents answer a search, in all and by category, whatever the

and those under repair, with the figures of the inventory.

the period, what remains free, and those loans. The loan being edited is
left out: its own pieces do not stand in its way.

Rewrite an equipment whole, such as the pieces put back in service.

Fewer pieces offered are refused if a loan to come would then lack some.

The loans that take an equipment, from the Monday of this week, for
eleven weeks.

The events of the board, by page.

Upcoming events come the next first; past ones, like the whole list, the
latest first. An event stays upcoming until the end of its last day.

delete.description: Delete an event, with its programme and practical info.

come, then those over, the latest first. A state keeps its own.

Record a loan, never beyond what is free over its days (A15): a loan to
someone takes the next number of its year.

the committee and those returned too, the cancelled left out.

Rewrite a loan whole, its lines replaced, never beyond what is free over
its days, its own pieces left out.

which takes the link of the loan. A committee loan has none.

before its start, and is refused if it is not free by then.

is reported. The loans to come that the repairs leave short are named.

each with its replies.
get.summary: List the notes of an event

post.description: Record a note of the signed-in member, on an event or general.

get.description:
The notes without an event (A11), by page, in the same order as an
event's, each with its replies.

delete.description: Delete a note with its replies, or a reply. Only its author finds it.

put.description: Rewrite a note or a reply. Only its author finds it: anyone else gets a 404.

post.description: Record a reply of the signed-in member. A reply cannot be answered: 404.

get.description: The dashboard's figures, whole: a bounded aggregate, never paginated.
A size of any photo, published or not.

parameters.description: A size of a photo smaller than its image, named after its field.
parameters.name: rendition

schema.description: A size of a photo smaller than its image, named after its field.
schema.title: PhotoRendition

200.description: The photo, in the size asked for

put.description: Rewrite a reservation, its places replaced: only an increase meets the capacity.

delete.description: Delete a station, with the people at it.

post.summary: Put a volunteer at a station

get.description:
Every item, by category then by name, with its quantity, whether it is
low, how full its bar is and its value; the figures of the chips; the latest
stocktake; the latest operations; the shopping list and its budget; the
orders to receive; the value of the stock.

delete.description: Delete an item that has never moved: the history keeps the others.

put.description: Rewrite an item whole: its movements stay as they are.

post.description:
A click on minus or plus: the item's step, in or out, recorded with the member.
Out, what is left when less than a step is.
post.summary: Adjust a stock item by its step

get.description:
« Fiche de stock »: the movements of an item, the latest first, each
valued, with the stock, its value and its average cost after it.
get.summary: Read the stock card of an item

get.description:
The operations, the latest first: all of them, or the purchases and
deliveries waiting for the cost of a line.
get.summary: List the operations of the stock

post.description:
« Entrée ou sortie »: several items in or out at once, for one reason,
recorded with the member. An exit never takes more than is in stock.
post.summary: Record an entry or an exit of the stock

get.description: An operation and its lines, each valued at the cost of its time.
get.summary: Read an operation of the stock

put.description:
« Compléter les prix », « Corriger les prix »: what each line cost, every
line at once. The quantities stay as they are.
put.summary: Write the costs of a purchase or a delivery

get.description: What an order brings to the stock, and whether it was received.
get.summary: Read the lines and the delivery of an order

delete.description:
« Annuler »: the delivery is undone the day it was received, unless one
of its items has moved, or a stocktake has counted it, since.
delete.summary: Cancel the delivery of an order

post.description:
« Réceptionner la livraison »: each line of a validated order comes into
the stock, by a single delivery of the member.
post.summary: Receive the delivery of an order

put.description:
The lines of an order, all at once, until it is received: without any,
the order leaves the Stock page.
put.summary: Write the lines of an order

post.description:
« Faire l'inventaire »: each difference between what was counted and
what the stock held becomes a movement of a single stocktake.

get.description: The tasks of an event, by page: open first by due date, then those done.
get.summary: List the tasks of an event

post.description: Record a task of the signed-in member.

get.description: The tasks without an event (D10), by page, in the same order as an event's.

put.description: Rewrite a task whole: ticking it done records when.

delete.description: Delete a type of place no reservation uses: one in use is refused (422).

get.description: The journal, by page, the latest entry first.

post.description:
Record an entry, from the form of the journal: a field left empty is not
sent. A file sent with it is its receipt, filed among the documents.

category.description: What an entry is for: each kind has its own categories, « Divers » both.
category.title: LedgerCategory

delete.description: Delete an entry: its receipt stays among the documents.

put.description: Rewrite an entry whole: its receipt and its reimbursement stay as they are.

post.description:
« Joindre le justificatif »: the document that proves an entry that has
none, filed among the documents.
post.summary: Join the receipt of a ledger entry

delete.description: « Annuler le remboursement »: the advance is owed again.
delete.summary: Cancel the reimbursement of an advance

post.description:
« Marquer remboursée »: the advance of a member is paid back, its line
completed; no second expense is written (A18).

delete.description: « Retirer »: the expense pays the purchase no more; it stays in the stock.
delete.summary: Unlink the stock purchase of an expense

post.description:
« Mettre en stock » (D16): the purchase an expense paid, recorded in the
stock with its label and its event, each line with its cost.
post.summary: Put in stock what an expense paid

put.description:
« Achat déjà saisi » (D16): a purchase or a delivery recorded in the
stock is paid by the expense, the cost of each line given. Given again, its
costs are corrected.
put.summary: Link a stock purchase to the expense that paid it

post.description:
« Ligne déjà saisie »: an invoice becomes the receipt of an expense
entered without one, rather than an expense recorded twice.
post.summary: Attach an invoice to the expense it proves

post.description:
« Valider et créer l'écriture », « Marquer payée »: the expense of an
invoice at the date it was paid, the invoice as its receipt, validated if it
awaited review.
post.summary: Record the expense of an invoice

get.description:
« Contrôle de gestion » (D16): the management result of each event once
its goods are counted, the value of the stock and its change over the
year, the reconciliation of the results, and what the figures wait for.
get.summary: Read the management control of a fiscal year

get.description:
« Bilan pour l'AG »: the totals and results of a fiscal year, what each
category brought in or cost, and the expenses missing their receipt.
get.summary: Read the report of a fiscal year for the general meeting

get.description:
What a fiscal year brought in and cost: in all, for each event that has
entries in it, the first to start first, then for the general running.
get.summary: Read the results of a fiscal year

get.description:
The purchases and deliveries of the stock no expense paid yet, the
latest first: what « Achat déjà saisi » chooses from.
get.summary: List the stock purchases no expense paid

get.description: Report whether the service can answer, and which release is running.
The categories of the agenda's events, and when the board last changed one.
Every published event, past ones included: a subscribed calendar keeps them.
The published events to come, the next first, by page.
A published event's page, past ones included, with the events that follow it.
A published event, to add to one's calendar.
